# Jordan Fein — Director

> Jordan Fein is an Emmy-nominated, Texas-raised director of commercials, documentary and film, based in New York and Los Angeles. His work spans commercial, celebrity and unscripted storytelling.

- Website: https://jordanfein.com/
- IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/name/nm3583341/
- Vimeo: https://vimeo.com/jordanfein
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jordanfein/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jordan-fein-10aa011b/
- Contact: jdfein@gmail.com
